title: Grateful Dead Live at Hilton Hotel on 1969-03-15
source: Source: SBD > Bear's cassette > ??? > Sony ESXHiFi/L-750 beta tape; Transfer: PCM (Sony SL-10) > Sony PCM-601ESD > Behringer Ultramatch Pro > Tascam DA-3000 (wav 16-bit/44.1k); Lineage: wav > iZotope RX6 Advanced > iZotope Ozone 5 Advanced > CD Wave > TLH > Flac 16; edited and mastered SIRMick February 2018

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording of a classic ’69 Dead show that dazzles with its raw energy, though early jams are uneven and Garcia’s slide work is still tentative.
ai_review.review: The set captures the quintessential 1969 Grateful Dead vibe – Jerry’s playing is spirited but his slide technique hasn’t fully matured yet, and Pigpen comes across as a bit off‑kilter. While the recording is clear and faithful to the board mix, listeners note that the first half feels shaky until the later songs pick up momentum.

ai_rating.rationale: One reviewer gives a perfect score for overall excitement, another rates it only average due to performance issues; recording quality is uncomplained and solid, leading to a balanced mid‑high rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No complaints about clarity or mix – the board capture is clean. Minor user note about track labeling gaps but no impact on audio fidelity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Early portion of the show feels rough with tentative slide work and a less focused Pigpen, but the energy improves later in the set as jams start clicking.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia is still learning slide technique; his playing sounds tentative.
